Style guide

@codecaine-ai/design-system: the one look shared by Codecaine and Lascari AI apps. 79 base and 192 theme tokens, light and dark. Every value on this page is a --ds-* custom property from dist/css/tokens.css.

Color roles

Semantic roles: what apps use. Each cell paints with the unqualified --ds-* var inside a data-theme cell, so light and dark render side by side.

Hues

Categorical color only. text is text-safe on page, panel and its own soft; solid is a tile whose glyph is on-solid (white or ink, whichever meets 4.5:1 on it); soft an opaque tint; line a hairline over a panel. Hover a cell for its value.
